patterns_found.behavior_notes: A feed like this commonly needs either a manual 'load more' trigger lower in the list or equivalent continuation behavior to reveal additional posts beyond the initially rendered set.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a relatively simple blog/archive feed with repeated post cards and a top search/control bar. Desktop appears mostly static aside from search behavior, while mobile suggests a long continuous reading stream where additional content loading is more likely to matter. No explicit menus, tabs, accordions, or modal triggers are drawn in the sketches themselves, so the main JavaScript complexity centers on search and potentially scroll-driven feed continuation.
